description: A driver implementation for sending and receiving mcumgr packets over UART in Zephyr OS, including buffer management, UART interrupt handling, and asynchronous operation support.

methods.name: uart_mcumgr_alloc_rx_buf
methods.description: Allocates a receive buffer from the memory slab.

methods.name: uart_mcumgr_free_rx_buf
methods.description: Frees a receive buffer back to the memory slab.

methods.name: uart_mcumgr_read_chunk
methods.description: Reads a chunk of data from UART hardware (if not async).

methods.name: uart_mcumgr_rx_byte
methods.description: Processes a single received byte, managing buffer and line completion.

methods.name: uart_mcumgr_async
methods.description: Handles UART events asynchronously when CONFIG_MCUMGR_TRANSPORT_UART_ASYNC is enabled.

methods.name: uart_mcumgr_isr
methods.description: Interrupt Service Routine for UART reception when async is not enabled.

methods.name: uart_mcumgr_send
methods.description: Sends a packet over UART using mcumgr serial transport.

methods.name: uart_mcumgr_setup
methods.description: Initializes UART hardware for reception, either async or interrupt-driven.

methods.name: uart_mcumgr_register
methods.description: Registers a callback for received mcumgr packets and sets up UART.
